description: Replace the complete Shopify cart after buyer confirmation. Requires id and cart_access_token. Read the cart first, then send cart.line_items containing every item to retain with item.id (ProductVariant GID), quantity, and optional existing line id. Omitted lines are removed; [] empties the cart. This does not place an order.

cart_access_token.description: Owner credential returned by create_cart for this cart id.

name: update_cart
title: Update Shopify cart
